== Biography ==
'''Janet Glasgow''' was baptised at Libberton, Lanarkshire, on 22 Apr 1718. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4169|Robert Glasgow]] and her mother as [[Gibson-37713|Katherin Gibson]].<ref name="FMP1" /> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Libberton is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-4168]] is assessed at 91% (proved). Janet’s 1718 transcript names Robert and Katherin Gibson. Robert-4168 now incorporates her former father account after the merger, but combining the Gibson, Wilson and Watson households remains an inference; father-role certainty exceeds that common-man identification.

Existing child-to-father link assessed from held public evidence; The merged account covers Gibson, Wilson and Watson entries; one common man, maternal identities and overlap with Robert-3407 remain unresolved.

Next useful test: Compare original 1718 residence/witnesses with the 1720 Gladhaimb and 1726 Whitrafles entries.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4033250&tab=this Libberton Janet, Robert Glasgow/Katherin Gibson,22 April 1718]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The baptism is the only record found for Janet Glasgow; it establishes her parents and baptism but gives no later life, marriage or death.

A possible identification concerns Joannet Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Joannet Glasgow and Andrew Allexander/ on 8 August 1661 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 230; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
